text:
IncidentBot: Pager: runtime queue depth spiking in us-west-1. metric=runtime.inflight_pct 95th=98%. alerts: queue_high, p99_latency_up.
jen (oncall): on it, paging runtime team. assigning to marco.
marco: looking now — seeing a sustained burst from tenant acct-9876 hitting a pattern of long structured-output requests, KV cache growth, significant tail latency.
marco: root hypothesis: a customer A/B test is sending long sequences with function-calling + structured output, keeping sessions alive. that pins lanes.
priya: do we have a quick mitigation? need to protect other tenants.
marco: proposing immediate live mitigations: 1) reduce per-tenant max_inflight from 20 -> 6 for non-enterprise tenants; 2) enable best-effort shedding for tenant acct-9876 (drop low-priority requests); 3) temporarily disable structured-output postprocessing at the router level; 4) shorten idle request timeout 60s -> 30s.
jen (oncall): agree. execute in order and post commands. I'll coordinate comms.
marco: running command to set inflight cap for non-enterprise pool:
```
/ops set-pool-config --pool=us-west-1-nonprod --max-inflight-per-tenant=6
```
marco: toggling shedding policy for acct-9876:
```
/ops tenant-config set --tenant=acct-9876 --shed=best-effort
```
marco: flipping feature flag to disable structured-output enrichment on router (will keep model generation unchanged):
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/flags -d '{"flag":"structured_output_v2","state":"off","scope":"us-west-1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
deploy-bot: rollout initiated for flag structured_output_v2 in us-west-1 (change-id: ch_489765).
carol (support): prepping customer notification for acct-9876 and affected tenants — draft: "We're seeing elevated request latencies and are applying temporary limits; you may observe dropped or delayed requests. We're working to restore normal operation." anyone want to add technical detail?
priya: add note about temporary disable of structured-output and expected ~10-20% reduction in rich outputs. mention target ETA 2h.
jen (oncall): command to shorten idle timeout:
```
/ops runtime-config set --region=us-west-1 --idle-timeout-seconds=30
```
marco: metrics update after changes (2m): queue depth down to 48% and p99 latency reduced ~35%. sending graphs.
marco: still seeing a tail for long-lived sessions — will evict sessions idle > 10s in the router cache as a follow-up.
priya: can we safely evict? any risk to in-progress streaming?
marco: we'll only evict sessions with no active stream handle; safe. running eviction patch now:
```
/ops router-evict --region=us-west-1 --idle-threshold=10
```
jen (oncall): good work. priya, please open a post-incident ticket to track permanent fixes (rate limiter per-route, structured-output cost cap, tenant-level autoslice).
priya: opened INC-48976 with action items and owners. link: https://tickets/redwood/INC-48976
carol (support): notified top 5 affected customers, including acct-9876. acct-9876 responded: "Thanks, we're going to pause the test on our side too."
marco: monitoring — p99 stable, error-rate normalizing. will hold mitigations for 30m then start gradual rollback of most aggressive limits except structured-output flag which we'll leave off until root cause remediation.
jen (oncall): plan for rollback: 1) restore idle-timeout to 45s, 2) increase max_inflight to 10, 3) keep structured-output off until PR merging cost controls. execute if metrics stable for 30m.
marco: executing step 1 now:
```
/ops runtime-config set --region=us-west-1 --idle-timeout-seconds=45
```
marco: idle-timeout rollback done.
marco: increasing inflight cap to 10:
```
/ops set-pool-config --pool=us-west-1-nonprod --max-inflight-per-tenant=10
```
deploy-bot: pool config updated (change-id: ch_489765_b).
marco: metrics post-rollback: queue depth stable at ~55%, p99 within SLO.
jen (oncall): leaving structured-output off, devs to add cost guard rails and per-request token ceiling. marco/priya pair to own the follow-up.
priya: noted. I'll schedule a postmortem sync with infra and product tomorrow.
jen (oncall): closing this mitigation thread. Will monitor for next 2 hours, reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:
